assumptions: Identity source is env config (human decision option (a), fork F3 = (a)): CANARY_GUARDIAN_LOGIN replaces the github-actions[bot] default; CANARY_GUARDIAN_APP_SLUG adds the App-bot match.
Empty or whitespace-only values count as unset; values are trimmed.
The env is read only at the CLI edge (identityFromEnv in ts/src/guardian/cli.ts) and passed down as a parameter; pr-comment.ts and adjudication-github.ts stay env-free.
GitHubAdjudicationSource (the precision command) also takes the identity, because the recorded human decision on the issue names it alongside upsertStickyComment.

The issue's repro test as written calls upsertStickyComment with no identity, which cannot pass under the decided design (no auto-detection); it is reproduced through the production CLI path with the env set, plus a unit case that passes the identity explicitly.
The mission-briefing comment (ts/src/briefing/comment.ts) also upserts by author with the default identity; it is out of scope here and left unchanged.
